description: Reviewed baseline for CROCO_STATIC_RAW_ERROR_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY. New production raw built-in Error throws must be converted or added with owner and unexpired expiresOn metadata.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("Execution manager does not support audit log append");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): recoverExecution refuses retry without the manager audit-log capability. createRetryConsole.runRecovery converts this adapter rejection into status=failed and admin-ops/provider-recovery-failed; no retry executes without the audit append.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("Execution manager does not support replay");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): recoverExecution rejects a replay-capability mismatch. createRetryConsole.runRecovery owns the public failed-result diagnostic; this private adapter guard must not invent a second recovery Problem contract.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("Lifecycle recovery provider is not configured");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): createLifecycleRetryConsoleSource rejects an absent optional recovery callback. The normal console hides unsupported recovery actions and runRecovery normalizes a direct adapter rejection into a failed result.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error(`Lifecycle run '${item.id}' was not found`);
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): The lifecycle source rejects a run that vanished between console selection and provider lookup. runRecovery owns normalization into a failed result; this guard prevents calling recover with a missing run.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("maxSize must be at least 1");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): ErrorHistoryRingBuffer rejects a nonpositive capacity before allocating or recording diagnostics. This constructor programmer/configuration assertion has no request recovery state; retain the current thrown-Error contract until a separately reviewed configuration diagnostic replaces it.

Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): assertProblemExhaustive accepts never and throws for an unhandled runtime variant. This is a programmer assertion outside the declared domain Problem union; turning it into another domain Problem would change the exhaustive failure contract.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("CacheStore returned no ISR response");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): CacheStore.getOrSet permits undefined, including invalidated in-flight loads. The current ISR middleware promises its caller a Response and rejects this no-response outcome. Retain that existing rejection during exception maintenance; changing invalidation, fallback rendering or the public error model requires a separate ISR behavior review.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error("Missing package version in package.json");
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): getPackageVersion checks the statically imported package manifest used by the CLI version option. Missing metadata is a broken build/package invariant, not a migration apply failure; preserve startup rejection until the packaging boundary supplies a dedicated diagnostic.

Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): The conformance Unit of Work callback deliberately throws to verify rollback removes the record. This is an injected test failure, not an outbox delivery failure; replacing it with a successful result would invalidate the transaction probe.

Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): assertProblemExhaustive accepts never and throws for an unhandled runtime variant. This is a programmer assertion outside the declared domain Problem union; preserve it without introducing a recursive UnhandledProblem variant.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error(`Unknown contract graph consumer '${consumerId}'.`);
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): getConsumerDefinition accepts only the closed ContractGraphConsumerId union. A missing definition is an invalid programmer-supplied consumer identity, not a valid graph diagnostic; preserve rejection instead of inventing coverage for an unknown consumer.

entries.excerpt: throw new Error(\`Unhandled RPC Problem variant\${suffix}\`);
entries.reason: Reviewed 2026-10-30 (#4004): The generated assertExhaustiveProblem helper accepts never and throws for an unhandled runtime variant. The template intentionally matches the standalone helpers; introducing a domain Problem would change generated consumer behavior and its declared union.
